note: Clean catalog plus PTB-aligned software documentation, update planning, unit-test planning, local resource reuse, Last-Git-Commit references and system-plan expansion. TASKS.TXT and shortcut commands are export hooks, not catalog entries.
parameter_control_rule: Parameter influence context budget and risk posture only; they do not create extra catalog entries.
feature_refactor_overlay_note: Overlay scale entries were removed because they created duplicate pseudo-plans.

autonomous_feature_policy.randomness_policy: No arbitrary random features. Seeded choice is allowed only as a tie-breaker between equally evidenced, low-risk candidates.
autonomous_feature_policy.write_gate: Patch only when autonomy_level permits it and risk is low/medium with explicit rollback.
autonomous_feature_policy.fallback: If evidence is weak, emit proposal_only with known_gaps instead of editing files.

documentation_test_resource_policy.documentation: Software documentation is feature-only and must select exactly one PTB/WELMEC schema profile when PTB mode is used.
documentation_test_resource_policy.testing: Unit-test plans prefer existing frameworks and fixtures; no unproven dependency installation.
documentation_test_resource_policy.reuse: Feature and refactor entries must inspect local resources before creating parallel implementations.
documentation_test_resource_policy.refactor: Refactor remains behavior-preserving; docs and fixes stay out of the refactor catalog.

last_git_commit_reference_policy.scan_trigger: Selecting feature_last_git_commit_reference or refactor_last_git_commit_hardening triggers the Patch-tab read-only Git scan before Prompt Builder compilation.
last_git_commit_reference_policy.export_trigger: The Export-tab LAST-GIT-COMMIT checkbox also enables Reference D in USER_PROMPT and manifests.
last_git_commit_reference_policy.boundary: Commit metadata is context only; no diff, remote URL, secret or Git write operation is exported.

tasks_sidecar_policy.automatic_trigger: When Prompt Builder left CUSTOM_USER_PROMPT input exists, parse JSON/list/plain text and write TASKS.TXT as a sidecar outside ZIP/folder output.
tasks_sidecar_policy.create_tab_boundary: Create Preview may display pipeline awareness, but TASKS.TXT is not a Create-Tab plan, chain entry, specialization, or selectable slice.
tasks_sidecar_policy.manifest_rule: Declare TASKS.TXT in outside_files/artifacts only when generated.

shortcut_command_policy.contract: USER_PROMPT introduces these as immediate user CMD meanings and CMD.json mirrors them as machine-readable command metadata.
shortcut_command_policy.guardrail: Commands do not expand tool rights, repository access, scope, validation boundaries, or safety limits.

create_new_abstraction_plan_policy.rule: New abstraction plans are first-class Create-mode entries. Each listed abstraction is standalone, stack-category-bound and must not be grouped into a compound plan.
create_new_abstraction_plan_policy.feature_refactor_boundary: Feature/Refactor entries may package, extend or refactor an existing verified project only after Build.complete or Start-tab evidence.
create_new_abstraction_plan_policy.stack_category_rule: Create New Abstraction entries must declare category, stack_category, catalog_category and a matching create_stack_nodes entry with chain_boilerplate_ids.
